findings.reason: the author must specify how a PSRC-only record is represented (optional/empty psi-grid fields, or a distinct record), otherwise the SELENE loader the section designs cannot be built against the record it names.
findings.text: the changed text states the SELENE loader's `EfitLabels` "has no psirz, grid or q95" (line 687) and "holds only what PSRC has", but `EfitLabels` declares `psirz`, `grid_r_m` and `grid_z_m` as required dataclass fields with no defaults (imas_ambix/challenge/loader.py:56-58), so the loader cannot construct the record it is said to return, and §6's account ("gains only the last-closed-surface point arrays its boundary sample needs") names no optionality or retirement

findings.reason: with §6 now stating the record carries no psi or grid, this sentence must be corrected to the builder's actual inputs or the loader's reuse claim is unbuildable.
findings.text: §7 says "the loader passes the record's grid, psi, axis and boundary arrays to that builder", but `build_geometry_from_arrays` (imas_ambix/worldmodel/equilibrium_labels.py:465-477) takes `lcfs_r/lcfs_z`, `axis_r/axis_z`, `lcfs_r/lcfs_z` and the X-point arrays and takes no psi and no grid, so the reuse it describes routes through a builder whose interface does not match
